query: Which change-detection approach (post-classification comparison, time-series classification, BFAST, CCDC) yields the most robust detection of LULC transitions at decadal and inter-annual scales for county-level studies?

response.query: Which change-detection approach (post-classification comparison, time-series classification, BFAST, CCDC) yields the most robust detection of LULC transitions at decadal and inter-annual scales for county-level studies?
response.answer: BFAST yields the most robust detection of LULC transitions at decadal and inter-annual scales for county-level studies. It is specifically designed for time-series analysis of land cover changes. This method is widely recognized for its accuracy and efficiency.
